decision_conditions: The development must be begun not later than the expiration of three years from the date of the original planning permission reference DM2023/01511 (granted on 19th December 2024).  Reason: To comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended.

All external facing materials, treatments and finishes shall be as per the approved External Facing Materials document (October 2023) and maintained and retained thereafter. This applies unless differences are shown on the drawings we have approved.  Reason: To ensure that the extension harmonises with the existing building and to ensure compliance with Policy 28 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development hereby approved shall be constructed and landscaped in accordance with the full details of hard and soft landscaping as approved under planning reference CLC2025/00024.Reason: To ensure the provision, establishment and maintenance of a reasonable standard of landscape in accordance with the approved designs in accordance with Policy 28 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development hereby approved shall be constructed in accordance with the protective tree measures as approved under planning reference CLC2025/00186.Reason: To satisfy the Local Planning Authority that the tree(s) to be retained will not be damaged during demolition or construction and to ensure tree(s) significant in terms of their provision of local amenity are protected from construction damage, in accordance with best practice and Policy 28 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development hereby approved shall be constructed in accordance with the acoustic scheme as approved under planning reference CLC2025/00024 to demonstrate that the noise level of 35 dB LAeq, 16 hour in living rooms and bedrooms during the daytime (0700 to 2300 hours) and 30 dB LAeq, 8 hour during the night time (2300 to 0700 hours) in bedrooms, in accordance with BS8233:2014, shall not be exceeded. Noise levels in bedrooms should also not normally exceed 45 dB LAmax, F more than 10 times during the night time. Where these levels cannot be met with windows open appropriate acoustic ventilation should be provided so that the room can be sufficiently ventilated. The acoustic performance of any passive vent, variable speed mechanical air supply unit or whole house ventilation must be sufficient to ensure that the noise level standards given above are not compromised. The approved details shall be installed prior to the development being occupied and retained thereafter.  Reason: To ensure that the future occupants are not exposed to unwarranted extraneous noise in accordance with policy D6 of the London Plan and Policy 9 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

Site construction works shall only be carried out between the hours of 0800 and 1800 hours Monday to Friday, 0800 and 1300 hours on Saturday and not at all on Sundays and Bank Holidays.  Reason: To protect neighbouring amenities in accordance with policy 29 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

Prior to occupation of the development the car parking shall be laid out in accordance with drawing no. 21-215-P008C and shall be retained thereafter for the life time of the development.  Reason: To comply with Policy 37 of the Sutton Local Plan.

The development hereby approved shall be constructed in accordance with the secure cycle storage facility details as approved under planning reference CLC2025/00024. The approved details shall be implemented on site prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved and thereafter permanently retained in accordance with the approved details.  Reason: To ensure the development provides an adequate level of cycle parking facilities and to encourage sustainable modes of transport, in accordance with Policies 36 and 37 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development hereby approved shall be monitored and reported in accordance with the post-construction energy demand and carbon emissions plan as approved under planning reference CLC2025/00051 for five years in accordance with Mayoral guidance on 'Be Seen' (GLA, 2022).  Reason: To comply with Policy 31 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development hereby approved shall be constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Statement v.2.0 prepared by Sustain Quality Ltd and dated 2 April 2024. Prior to first occupation, 'as-built' Standard Assessment Procedure (SAP) outputs must be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to demonstrate that the development has achieved the targeted reduction in CO2 emissions. All of the approved measures must thereafter be retained for as long as the development is in existence.  Reason: To comply with Policy 31 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development hereby approved shall be constructed in accordance with the heat risk management strategy and TM59 assessment approved under planning reference CLC2025/00051 and the altered ventilation details approved under DM2026/00513. All of the approved cooling and ventilation measures must thereafter be retained for as long as the development is in existence.Reason: To comply with Policy 31 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development hereby approved shall be implemented in accordance with the Water Efficiency Calculator for New Dwellings details as approved under planning reference CLC2025/00051 to show that internal potable water consumption for each of the dwellings will be limited to 110 litres per person per day (l/p/d) based on the Government's national calculation method for the purposes of Part G of the Building Regulations.  Reason: To comply with Policy 33 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the scheme for biodiversity protection and enhancements as approved under planning reference CLC2026/00028. Work shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved scheme and thereafter retained.  Reason: To enhance the biodiversity value of the land in accordance with Policy 26 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The windows shown to be obscure glazed as per drawing no. 21-215-P010 C shall be glazed with obscure glass and fixed shut to a height of 1.7 metres above the finished floor level of the room in which the window is installed in a manner that they cannot be opened and retained thereafter.  Reason: To safeguard the current level of privacy enjoyed by the occupants of adjoining properties in accordance with policy 29 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development must be carried out in accordance with the provisions of the Fire Strategy Statement prepared by Vita Group.  Reason: To ensure that the development incorporates the necessary fire safety measures in accordance with the Mayor's London Plan Policy D12.
description: Application to vary condition 12 of planning permission DM2023/01511 for the ''Demolition of existing dwelling and erection of a detached two storey building with accommodation in the roof space comprising 16 units in connection with the use of the property as a supported living care home, altered vehicular and pedestrian  access to/from Mollison Drive and Stafford Road , provision of vehicular parking, erection of a detached single storey cycle store,  integrated refuse store to the rear of the building, associated hard and soft landscaping, provision of amenity areas and provision of new boundary treatments.'' to allow for alterations to the ventilation method.
